BIC: 1bfc9d0cc2e5e
igation:** The fix commit `ae33192d31` changes a single line in `RemoveVmCommand.java`, inside the catch block of `removeCinderDisks()`, replacing `failedRemo

veCinderDisks.addAll(cinderDisks);` with `failedRemoveCinderDisks = cinderDisks;`. I ran `git log -p` on that file to find when this method/line was first introduced.

**(2) Spec
ific change:** Commit `1bfc9d0cc2` ("core: Support remove of VM with Cinder disks") added the entire `removeCinderDisks()` method.

failedRemoveCinderDisks` is initialized to `null` and is only assigned inside the `try` block. If an `InterruptedException` or `ExecutionException` is thrown, the assignment in the `try` never happens, so in

the `catch` block the variable is still `null`, and calling `.addAll(...)` on it throws a `NullPointerException`.

**(3) Evidence:** The fix diff exactly reverses this defect by
assigning the collection directly (`failedRemoveCinderDisks = cinderDisks;`) instead of calling `addAll` on a null reference. Tracing the file history confirms this exact line
, with the exact same null-initialization pattern, was introduced verbatim by `1bfc9d0cc2` and was never modified in
between (no intervening commits touch this method per `git log --oneline` on the file). I'm highly confident this is the bug-introducing commit.
